description: A portfolio built like a small product: 3D background, simple navigation, and one-screen project pages.

sections.title: The concept
sections.content:
The idea: a portfolio you can read fast, but with character. The content stays clear, and the 3D sets the mood without stealing the spotlight.

  • Light menu + direct navigation to each project.
  • No-scroll project pages, keeping the right side free for the 3D scene.
  • Performance-focused: lightweight load, stable animation.

sections.title: What I built
sections.content:
• Three.js / WebGL scene with a hologram look, designed to stay smooth.
  • Simple, maintainable UI: JSON-driven projects, dedicated project pages.
  • A printable CV (A4) for easy PDF export.
